description: This file defines a Java interface named Tamperable, representing devices with a tamper detection capability such as 'device case opened'. It declares methods for querying and setting the tamper state.

classes.name: Tamperable
classes.description: An interface that describes a tamperable device capability, including methods to query and set tamper status.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns true if the tamper switch is in the 'unsafe' position, indicating tampering.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tamper switch state to the specified boolean value.
